atoms.text: This guide describes how to let the Quillrun query service read input data from, and write query results to, the bucket acme-analytics-data. The service runs under the IAM role QuillrunQueryRole in account 111122223333, and access is granted entirely through an identity-based policy attached to that role. The bucket policy is not changed, so its existing statements and Block Public Access settings stay as they are. Create a customer managed policy with a statement that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:GetBucketLocation on arn:aws:s3:::acme-analytics-data, with an s3:prefix condition limited to raw/events/*. Add a second statement that allows s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::acme-analytics-data/raw/events/*. Add a third statement that allows s3:PutObject and s3:AbortMultipartUpload on arn:aws:s3:::acme-analytics-data/query-results/*. Attach the policy to QuillrunQueryRole and confirm that the role's trust policy allows the Quillrun service to assume it. Run a test query that reads from raw/events/ and verify that result files appear under query-results/. If the query fails with AccessDenied, check the role's attached policies, its permissions boundary, and any service control policy, because each of these can restrict the identity-based grant.

This guide describes how to let the Quillrun query service read input data from, and write query results to, the bucket acme-analytics-data. The service runs under the IAM role QuillrunQueryRole in account 111122223333, and access is granted entirely through statements in the bucket's resource-based policy. No identity-based policy for this bucket is added to the role, so the role's attached policies stay as they are. Edit the bucket policy and add a statement with Principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/QuillrunQueryRole that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:GetBucketLocation on arn:aws:s3:::acme-analytics-data, with an s3:prefix condition limited to raw/events/*. Add a second statement for the same principal that allows s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::acme-analytics-data/raw/events/*. Add a third statement for the same principal that allows s3:PutObject and s3:AbortMultipartUpload on arn:aws:s3:::acme-analytics-data/query-results/*. Save the bucket policy and confirm that the role's trust policy allows the Quillrun service to assume it. Run a test query that reads from raw/events/ and verify that result files appear under query-results/. If the query fails with AccessDenied, check that the Principal ARN is spelled exactly, and look for explicit Deny statements in the bucket policy or a service control policy.

This guide covers granting the Ledgerflow batch ETL runner access to the bucket northwind-lake. The runner reads raw log files from logs/raw/ and writes converted columnar files to logs/parquet/. It executes as the IAM role LedgerflowJobRole, and the permissions come only from an inline identity-based policy on that role. The bucket policy is left unmodified, including any existing Deny statements for non-TLS requests. In the inline policy, allow s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::northwind-lake with an s3:prefix condition of logs/raw/*. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::northwind-lake/logs/raw/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::northwind-lake/logs/parquet/*. Do not include s3:DeleteObject, so the runner cannot remove source files. Start a job against a single day of logs and check that the output objects in logs/parquet/ are owned by the bucket-owning account. If the job reports AccessDenied on a write, compare the object key prefix in the job configuration with the resource ARN in the policy.

This guide explains how to let an analyst, using the IAM user mkaur-analyst, run ad hoc SQL queries in the Sift console against the bucket corp-warehouse-exports. Sift reads the exported tables from the prefix tables/ and stores each query's result files under adhoc-results/mkaur/. Access is granted only by an identity-based policy attached to the IAM user mkaur-analyst. The bucket policy is not edited, and no other principal's access changes. Create a managed policy that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:GetBucketLocation on arn:aws:s3:::corp-warehouse-exports. Add a statement allowing s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::corp-warehouse-exports/tables/*. Add a statement allowing s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::corp-warehouse-exports/adhoc-results/mkaur/*, then attach the policy to the user. Have the analyst run a SELECT query in Sift and confirm that a result file appears under the user's results prefix. If the console shows AccessDenied, check whether a permissions boundary on the user omits the S3 actions.

This guide explains how to let an analyst, using the IAM user mkaur-analyst, run ad hoc SQL queries in the Sift console against the bucket corp-warehouse-exports. Sift reads the exported tables from the prefix tables/ and stores each query's result files under adhoc-results/mkaur/. Access is granted only by statements in the bucket's resource-based policy naming that user as the principal. The IAM user has no new identity-based policy, and no other principal's access changes. Add a bucket policy statement with Principal arn:aws:iam::777788889999:user/mkaur-analyst that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:GetBucketLocation on arn:aws:s3:::corp-warehouse-exports. Add a statement for the same principal allowing s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::corp-warehouse-exports/tables/*. Add a statement for the same principal allowing s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::corp-warehouse-exports/adhoc-results/mkaur/*, then save the policy. Have the analyst run a SELECT query in Sift and confirm that a result file appears under the user's results prefix. If the console shows AccessDenied, check that the user ARN in the Principal element matches the user's current name.

This guide describes the access needed for the Tidepool compaction service, which merges small ingested files into larger ones in the bucket stream-ingest-prod. Tidepool reads the small files under ingest/small-files/ and writes the merged output to ingest/compacted/. The service assumes the IAM role TidepoolCompactorRole, and the grant is made through an identity-based policy attached to that role. The bucket policy is not touched, so the bucket's lifecycle rules and existing statements are unaffected. In the role's policy, allow s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::stream-ingest-prod with an s3:prefix condition covering ingest/small-files/*. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::stream-ingest-prod/ingest/small-files/*. Allow s3:PutObject and s3:AbortMultipartUpload on arn:aws:s3:::stream-ingest-prod/ingest/compacted/*, because large merged files are uploaded in multiple parts. Trigger one compaction run and verify that the compacted files match the combined record count of their inputs. If a multipart upload stalls, confirm that the abort action is present in the role's policy.

This guide shows how to let the Reportly scheduler read curated sales data and write generated weekly reports in the bucket finance-curated. The scheduler runs as the IAM role ReportlyScheduleRole in account 555566667777. Reads come from the prefix curated/sales/ and report files are written to reports/weekly/. The only grant is an identity-based policy attached to ReportlyScheduleRole, and the bucket policy remains unchanged. Create the policy with s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::finance-curated, restricted by an s3:prefix condition of curated/sales/*. Include s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::finance-curated/curated/sales/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::finance-curated/reports/weekly/*. Attach the policy to the role and verify the trust relationship with the scheduler service. Run the schedule manually once and check that the report object has the expected key name and size. When an object is not found, remember that without s3:ListBucket the service receives AccessDenied instead of a not-found error.

This guide describes how to give the Featuremill feature-computation job access to the bucket ml-training-data. The job authenticates as the IAM user svc-featuremill, which holds an access key stored in the job's secret store. It reads event records from training/events/ and writes computed aggregates to features/daily/. Access is granted only through an identity-based policy attached to svc-featuremill, and the bucket policy is not modified. Create a managed policy that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:GetBucketLocation on arn:aws:s3:::ml-training-data. Add s3:GetObject for arn:aws:s3:::ml-training-data/training/events/*. Add s3:PutObject for arn:aws:s3:::ml-training-data/features/daily/*, then attach the policy to the user. Run the job for one date partition and confirm that a features/daily/ object is created for that date. If the job later needs a different prefix, update the policy statements on the user and leave the bucket configuration alone.

The job authenticates as the IAM user svc-featuremill, which holds an access key stored in the job's secret store. It reads event records from training/events/ and writes computed aggregates to features/daily/. Access is granted only through statements in the bucket's resource-based policy, and no identity-based policy is attached to svc-featuremill. Add a bucket policy statement with Principal arn:aws:iam::888899990000:user/svc-featuremill that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:GetBucketLocation on arn:aws:s3:::ml-training-data. Add a statement for that principal with s3:GetObject for arn:aws:s3:::ml-training-data/training/events/*. Add another with s3:PutObject for arn:aws:s3:::ml-training-data/features/daily/*, then save the policy. Run the job for one date partition and confirm that a features/daily/ object is created for that date. If the job later needs a different prefix, update the bucket policy statements and leave the user's configuration alone.

This guide covers access for the Logscope log analytics service to the versioned bucket edge-access-logs. Logscope reads delivered access log files from the prefix delivered/ and writes daily summary files to summaries/daily/. The service runs as the IAM role LogscopeAnalyzerRole in account 123456789012. The grant is an identity-based policy attached to the role, and the bucket policy is not altered. Because the bucket has versioning enabled, the policy must allow s3:GetObject and s3:GetObjectVersion on arn:aws:s3:::edge-access-logs/delivered/*. Add s3:ListBucket and s3:ListBucketVersions on arn:aws:s3:::edge-access-logs, restricted to the delivered/ prefix. Add s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::edge-access-logs/summaries/daily/*. Attach the policy to LogscopeAnalyzerRole and start an analysis for one day of logs. Confirm that a summary object is written and that the bucket now holds a new version for that key.

This guide covers access for the Logscope log analytics service to the versioned bucket edge-access-logs. Logscope reads delivered access log files from the prefix delivered/ and writes daily summary files to summaries/daily/. The service runs as the IAM role LogscopeAnalyzerRole in account 123456789012. The grant is a set of statements in the bucket's resource-based policy, and the role gets no identity-based policy for this bucket. Because the bucket has versioning enabled, a statement with Principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LogscopeAnalyzerRole must allow s3:GetObject and s3:GetObjectVersion on arn:aws:s3:::edge-access-logs/delivered/*. Add a statement for the same principal with s3:ListBucket and s3:ListBucketVersions on arn:aws:s3:::edge-access-logs, restricted to the delivered/ prefix. Add another statement for it with s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::edge-access-logs/summaries/daily/*. Save the bucket policy and start an analysis for one day of logs. Confirm that a summary object is written and that the bucket now holds a new version for that key.

This guide explains how to authorize the Datagate validation job to check incoming files in the bucket partner-landing-zone. The job reads uploaded files from landing/ and writes only validation report files to validation-reports/. It runs as the IAM role DatagateValidatorRole in account 987654321098. Access is provided exclusively by an identity-based policy on that role, and the bucket policy is not changed. Create a policy that allows s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::partner-landing-zone with an s3:prefix condition of landing/*. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::partner-landing-zone/landing/*. Allow s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::partner-landing-zone/validation-reports/*, with a condition requiring s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption to equal AES256. Attach the policy to DatagateValidatorRole and configure the job to send that encryption header on each write. Submit a test file to landing/ and verify that the job produces a report object and cannot write outside validation-reports/.
